PairSelectedCachedMask.lean:
import D1Bound5.PairCachedResidues

namespace D1Bound5

/-- Check one supplied rejecting position in the existing ordered cached
sieve. The same index selects the mask and both cached residues. Missing or
out-of-range entries reject the certificate; they never supply a default. -/
def pairSelectedCachedMaskRejectBool (tau nu : ℤ) (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ))
    (xs ys : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (i : ℕ) : Bool :=
  match sieve[i]?, xs[i]?, ys[i]? with
  | some (k, mask), some u, some v => !pairResidueMaskBool tau nu k mask u v
  | _, _, _ => false

/-- One genuinely rejecting aligned conjunct makes the entire original
cached sieve false. This is a statement about the exact old Boolean, so no
signature-validity, mask-validity, or discriminant assumption is needed. -/
theorem pairSelectedCachedMaskRejectBool_sound (tau nu : ℤ)
    (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (xs ys : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (i : ℕ)
    (hcheck : pairSelectedCachedMaskRejectBool tau nu sieve xs ys i = true) :
    pairCachedCoordinateSieveBool tau nu sieve xs ys = false := by
  induction i generalizing sieve xs ys with
  | zero =>
      cases sieve with
      | nil => simp [pairSelectedCachedMaskRejectBool] at hcheck
      | cons item sieve =>
          cases xs with
          | nil => rfl
          | cons u xs =>
              cases ys with
              | nil => rfl
              | cons v ys =>
                  rcases item with ⟨k, mask⟩
                  change (!pairResidueMaskBool tau nu k mask u v) = true at hcheck
                  change (pairResidueMaskBool tau nu k mask u v &&
                    pairCachedCoordinateSieveBool tau nu sieve xs ys) = false
                  cases hm : pairResidueMaskBool tau nu k mask u v with
                  | false => simp only [Bool.false_and]
                  | true =>
                      simp only [hm, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true] at hcheck
  | succ i ih =>
      cases sieve with
      | nil => simp [pairSelectedCachedMaskRejectBool] at hcheck
      | cons item sieve =>
          cases xs with
          | nil => rfl
          | cons u xs =>
              cases ys with
              | nil => rfl
              | cons v ys =>
                  change pairSelectedCachedMaskRejectBool tau nu sieve xs ys i = true at hcheck
                  have htail := ih sieve xs ys hcheck
                  rcases item with ⟨k, mask⟩
                  change (pairResidueMaskBool tau nu k mask u v &&
                    pairCachedCoordinateSieveBool tau nu sieve xs ys) = false
                  rw [htail, Bool.and_false]

end D1Bound5
PairSelectedFloorWitnesses.lean:
import D1Bound5.PairSelectedCachedMask
import D1Bound5.PairCachedFloorWitnesses

namespace D1Bound5
open QuadInt

/-- A base-32 word supplies one tag for every actual tail vertex. Tags 0--24
select one rejecting cached mask, tag 30 checks a repeated vertex, and tag 31
checks the existing integer obstruction or consumes one exact floor witness.
All other tags reject. The full tail drives recursion even when the packed
word is zero, so leading zero tags never omit pairs. At the end both the
remaining word and the floor list must be empty. -/
def pairSelectedFloorRowBool {tau nu : ℤ} (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ))
    (x : PairResidueVertex tau nu) :
    List (PairResidueVertex tau nu) → ℕ → List ℕ → Bool
  | [], code, ks => decide (code = 0 ∧ ks = [])
  | y :: ys, code, ks =>
      if code % 32 < 25 then
        pairSelectedCachedMaskRejectBool tau nu sieve x.signature y.signature (code % 32) &&
          pairSelectedFloorRowBool sieve x ys (code / 32) ks
      else if code % 32 = 30 then
        decide (x.vertex = y.vertex) && pairSelectedFloorRowBool sieve x ys (code / 32) ks
      else if code % 32 = 31 then
        if pairNegativeIntegerObstructionBool (x.vertex * y.vertex + 1) = true then
          pairSelectedFloorRowBool sieve x ys (code / 32) ks
        else match ks with
          | [] => false
          | k :: rest =>
              QuadInt.floorObstructionBool (x.vertex * y.vertex + 1) k &&
                pairSelectedFloorRowBool sieve x ys (code / 32) rest
      else false

/-- Every accepted tag rejects the exact cached pair test or checks an
actual repeated vertex. Thus all pairs in the entire tail are covered. -/
theorem pairSelectedFloorRowBool_sound {tau nu : ℤ}
    (hd : 0 < discriminant tau nu) (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ))
    (x : PairResidueVertex tau nu) (ys : List (PairResidueVertex tau nu))
    (code : ℕ) (ks : List ℕ)
    (hcheck : pairSelectedFloorRowBool sieve x ys code ks = true) :
    (ys.all fun y => if decide (x.vertex = y.vertex) then true
      else !(pairCachedHasSquareRoot sieve x y)) = true := by
  induction ys generalizing code ks with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons y ys ih =>
      by_cases hindex : code % 32 < 25
      · have hparts :
            pairSelectedCachedMaskRejectBool tau nu sieve x.signature y.signature
                (code % 32) = true ∧
              pairSelectedFloorRowBool sieve x ys (code / 32) ks = true :=
          Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp (by
            simpa only [pairSelectedFloorRowBool, if_pos hindex] using hcheck)
        have hcache := pairSelectedCachedMaskRejectBool_sound tau nu sieve
          x.signature y.signature (code % 32) hparts.1
        have hpair : pairCachedHasSquareRoot sieve x y = false := by
          simp only [pairCachedHasSquareRoot, hcache, Bool.false_and]
        simpa [hpair] using ih (code / 32) ks hparts.2
      · by_cases hrepeated : code % 32 = 30
        · have hparts : decide (x.vertex = y.vertex) = true ∧
                pairSelectedFloorRowBool sieve x ys (code / 32) ks = true :=
            Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp (by
              simpa only [pairSelectedFloorRowBool, if_neg hindex,
                if_pos hrepeated] using hcheck)
          have heq : x.vertex = y.vertex := of_decide_eq_true hparts.1
          simpa [heq] using ih (code / 32) ks hparts.2
        · by_cases hfallback : code % 32 = 31
          · by_cases hobs : pairNegativeIntegerObstructionBool (x.vertex * y.vertex + 1) = true
            · have htail : pairSelectedFloorRowBool sieve x ys (code / 32) ks = true := by
                simpa only [pairSelectedFloorRowBool, if_neg hindex,
                  if_neg hrepeated, if_pos hfallback, if_pos hobs] using hcheck
              have hpair := pairCachedHasSquareRoot_eq_false_of_no_root hd sieve x y
                (pairNegativeIntegerObstructionBool_sound _ hobs)
              simpa [hpair] using ih (code / 32) ks htail
            · cases ks with
              | nil =>
                  simp only [pairSelectedFloorRowBool, if_neg hindex,
                    if_neg hrepeated, if_pos hfallback, if_neg hobs,
                    Bool.false_eq_true] at hcheck
              | cons k rest =>
                  have hparts : QuadInt.floorObstructionBool (x.vertex * y.vertex + 1) k = true ∧
                      pairSelectedFloorRowBool sieve x ys (code / 32) rest = true :=
                    Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp (by
                      simpa only [pairSelectedFloorRowBool, if_neg hindex,
                        if_neg hrepeated, if_pos hfallback, if_neg hobs] using hcheck)
                  have hpair := pairCachedHasSquareRoot_eq_false_of_no_root hd sieve x y
                    (QuadInt.floorObstructionBool_sound hd hparts.1)
                  simpa [hpair] using ih (code / 32) rest hparts.2
          · simp only [pairSelectedFloorRowBool, if_neg hindex,
              if_neg hrepeated, if_neg hfallback, Bool.false_eq_true] at hcheck

/-- Exactly one packed word and floor list is required for each actual head.
Unmatched vertex or witness tails reject the certificate. -/
def pairSelectedFloorIndependentBool {tau nu : ℤ} (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ)) :
    List (PairResidueVertex tau nu) → List (ℕ × List ℕ) → Bool
  | [], [] => true
  | x :: xs, (code, ks) :: rows =>
      pairSelectedFloorRowBool sieve x xs code ks &&
        pairSelectedFloorIndependentBool sieve xs rows
  | _, _ => false

theorem pairSelectedFloorIndependentBool_sound {tau nu : ℤ}
    (hd : 0 < discriminant tau nu) (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ))
    (cached : List (PairResidueVertex tau nu)) (rows : List (ℕ × List ℕ))
    (hcheck : pairSelectedFloorIndependentBool sieve cached rows = true) :
    pairCachedIndependentBool sieve cached = true := by
  induction cached generalizing rows with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases rows with
      | nil => simp only [pairSelectedFloorIndependentBool, Bool.false_eq_true] at hcheck
      | cons item rows =>
          rcases item with ⟨code, ks⟩
          have hparts := Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hcheck
          apply Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mpr
          exact ⟨pairSelectedFloorRowBool_sound hd sieve x xs code ks hparts.1,
            ih rows hparts.2⟩

/-- The accepted complete color-list coverage and signature validation are
retained exactly, followed by the selected-mask and sparse-floor check. -/
def pairSelectedFloorIndependentCertificateBool {tau nu : ℤ}
    (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (vertices : List (QuadInt tau nu))
    (cached : List (PairResidueVertex tau nu)) (rows : List (ℕ × List ℕ)) : Bool :=
  decide (cached.map PairResidueVertex.vertex = vertices) &&
    ((cached.all fun x => decide (x.signature = pairCoordinateSignature sieve x.vertex)) &&
      pairSelectedFloorIndependentBool sieve cached rows)

theorem pairSelectedFloorIndependentCertificateBool_sound {tau nu : ℤ}
    (hd : 0 < discriminant tau nu) (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ))
    (vertices : List (QuadInt tau nu)) (cached : List (PairResidueVertex tau nu))
    (rows : List (ℕ × List ℕ))
    (hcheck : pairSelectedFloorIndependentCertificateBool sieve vertices cached rows = true) :
    pairCachedIndependentCertificateBool sieve vertices cached = true := by
  have hparts := Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hcheck
  have hrest := Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hparts.2
  apply Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mpr
  exact ⟨hparts.1, Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mpr
    ⟨hrest.1, pairSelectedFloorIndependentBool_sound hd sieve cached rows hrest.2⟩⟩

/-- The final assertion is the unchanged independent-class Boolean. The
selected tags, floor values, signatures, and vertex coverage are all checked. -/
theorem pairIndependentBool_of_selected_floor_certificate {tau nu : ℤ}
    (hd : 0 < discriminant tau nu) (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ))
    (vertices : List (QuadInt tau nu)) (cached : List (PairResidueVertex tau nu))
    (rows : List (ℕ × List ℕ))
    (hcheck : pairSelectedFloorIndependentCertificateBool sieve vertices cached rows = true) :
    pairIndependentBool sieve vertices = true :=
  pairIndependentBool_of_cached_certificate sieve vertices cached
    (pairSelectedFloorIndependentCertificateBool_sound hd sieve vertices cached rows hcheck)

end D1Bound5
PairCachedFloorChunks.lean:
import D1Bound5.PairCachedFloorWitnesses

namespace D1Bound5

/-- Check at most `n` head rows of the accepted sparse-floor checker.
Every row is evaluated against its entire actual remaining vertex tail.
The corresponding witness row is consumed in lockstep with its head;
unequal remaining list lengths reject as soon as they are encountered. -/
def pairCachedFloorPrefixBool {tau nu : ℤ} (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ)) :
    Nat → List (PairResidueVertex tau nu) → List (List ℕ) → Bool
  | 0, _, _ => true
  | _ + 1, [], [] => true
  | n + 1, x :: xs, ks :: rows =>
      pairCachedFloorRowBool sieve x xs ks &&
        pairCachedFloorPrefixBool sieve n xs rows
  | _ + 1, _, _ => false

/-- Literal Boolean factorization of the accepted sparse-floor checker.
No pair crossing the cut is lost: the earlier head is checked against
the full tail, including every vertex after the cut. Both the vertex and
witness lists are dropped by the same amount. -/
theorem pairCachedFloorIndependentBool_eq_prefix_drop {tau nu : ℤ}
    (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (n : Nat)
    (cached : List (PairResidueVertex tau nu)) (rows : List (List ℕ)) :
    pairCachedFloorIndependentBool sieve cached rows =
      (pairCachedFloorPrefixBool sieve n cached rows &&
        pairCachedFloorIndependentBool sieve (cached.drop n) (rows.drop n)) := by
  induction n generalizing cached rows with
  | zero =>
      simp only [pairCachedFloorPrefixBool, List.drop_zero, Bool.true_and]
  | succ n ih =>
      cases cached with
      | nil => cases rows <;> rfl
      | cons x xs =>
          cases rows with
          | nil => rfl
          | cons ks rows =>
              change
                (pairCachedFloorRowBool sieve x xs ks &&
                  pairCachedFloorIndependentBool sieve xs rows) =
                ((pairCachedFloorRowBool sieve x xs ks &&
                    pairCachedFloorPrefixBool sieve n xs rows) &&
                  pairCachedFloorIndependentBool sieve (xs.drop n) (rows.drop n))
              rw [ih xs rows, Bool.and_assoc]

/-- Assemble two independently checked pieces into exactly the previous
checker. This can be repeated for arbitrary block widths, including zero
or a width beyond the end; the final remainder must still be certified. -/
theorem pairCachedFloorIndependentBool_of_prefix_drop {tau nu : ℤ}
    (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (n : Nat)
    (cached : List (PairResidueVertex tau nu)) (rows : List (List ℕ))
    (hprefix : pairCachedFloorPrefixBool sieve n cached rows = true)
    (htail : pairCachedFloorIndependentBool sieve (cached.drop n) (rows.drop n) = true) :
    pairCachedFloorIndependentBool sieve cached rows = true :=
  (pairCachedFloorIndependentBool_eq_prefix_drop sieve n cached rows).trans
    (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mpr ⟨hprefix, htail⟩)

/-- A final prefix covering both lists leaves the original empty checker.
Length equality is not assumed: malformed unequal-length lists still fail
inside the checked prefix, including an extra final witness row. -/
theorem pairCachedFloorIndependentBool_of_prefix_cover {tau nu : ℤ}
    (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (n : Nat)
    (cached : List (PairResidueVertex tau nu)) (rows : List (List ℕ))
    (hcached : cached.length ≤ n) (hrows : rows.length ≤ n)
    (hprefix : pairCachedFloorPrefixBool sieve n cached rows = true) :
    pairCachedFloorIndependentBool sieve cached rows = true := by
  apply pairCachedFloorIndependentBool_of_prefix_drop sieve n cached rows hprefix
  rw [List.drop_eq_nil_of_le hcached, List.drop_eq_nil_of_le hrows]
  rfl

/-- Only independence is split. The original exact vertex projection and
the original full signature validation remain separate checked inputs. -/
theorem pairCachedFloorIndependentCertificateBool_of_prefix_drop {tau nu : ℤ}
    (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (vertices : List (QuadInt tau nu))
    (cached : List (PairResidueVertex tau nu)) (rows : List (List ℕ)) (n : Nat)
    (hcover : cached.map PairResidueVertex.vertex = vertices)
    (hvalid : (cached.all fun x =>
      decide (x.signature = pairCoordinateSignature sieve x.vertex)) = true)
    (hprefix : pairCachedFloorPrefixBool sieve n cached rows = true)
    (htail : pairCachedFloorIndependentBool sieve (cached.drop n) (rows.drop n) = true) :
    pairCachedFloorIndependentCertificateBool sieve vertices cached rows = true := by
  have hindependent :=
    pairCachedFloorIndependentBool_of_prefix_drop sieve n cached rows hprefix htail
  apply Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mpr
  refine ⟨?_, Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mpr ⟨hvalid, hindependent⟩⟩
  simp [hcover]

/-- Chunk composition reaches the exact original independent-class Boolean
through the accepted sparse-floor soundness theorem, preserving the full
meaning of every downstream graph certificate. -/
theorem pairIndependentBool_of_cached_floor_prefix_drop {tau nu : ℤ}
    (hd : 0 < QuadInt.discriminant tau nu) (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ))
    (vertices : List (QuadInt tau nu))
    (cached : List (PairResidueVertex tau nu)) (rows : List (List ℕ)) (n : Nat)
    (hcover : cached.map PairResidueVertex.vertex = vertices)
    (hvalid : (cached.all fun x =>
      decide (x.signature = pairCoordinateSignature sieve x.vertex)) = true)
    (hprefix : pairCachedFloorPrefixBool sieve n cached rows = true)
    (htail : pairCachedFloorIndependentBool sieve (cached.drop n) (rows.drop n) = true) :
    pairIndependentBool sieve vertices = true :=
  pairIndependentBool_of_cached_floor_certificate hd sieve vertices cached rows
    (pairCachedFloorIndependentCertificateBool_of_prefix_drop sieve vertices cached rows n
      hcover hvalid hprefix htail)

end D1Bound5
